metadata.question: In parts of East Midlands, northeast England, and eastern Scotland, was there more rain during October 1, 2023, and January 4, 2024 as compared to their 1991-2020 average rainfalls for those months?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS daily rainfall (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) for 0.05° global gridded precipitation. This dataset covers the full period (1991-present) and provides daily totals. 2. Geometry: Build one MultiPolygon covering (a) East Midlands, (b) north-east England, (c) eastern Scotland using approximate corner coordinates taken from publicly-available regional outlines (kept <100 pts total). 3. Time slices: - Recent period: 1 Oct 2023 – 4 Jan 2024 (inclusive) - Climatology: same calendar window (1 Oct – 4 Jan) for every year 1991-2020 → 30-year average 4. Processing: - Sum daily rainfall inside each window → total seasonal rainfall images. - Compute spatial mean over the combined region (reduceRegion, scale 5000 m, best-effort maxPixels). - Check collection sizes; if any is empty → C1. - After masking (none here) ensure pixel count >0; else C2. - If either mean is None/NaN → C3. 5. Logic: if recent mean > climatology mean → A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Region: East-Midlands + NE-England + E-Scotland (simplified MultiPolygon) reg = ee.Geometry.MultiPolygon( [[[[-1.0,53.5],[-1.0,52.7],[-0.3,52.7],[-0.3,53.5]], [[-2.3,55.8],[-2.3,54.7],[-0.5,54.7],[-0.5,55.8]], [[-3.8,56.3],[-3.8,55.7],[-2.0,55.7],[-2.0,56.3]]]]) # 2. Build climatology (1991-2020) for 1 Oct – 4 Jan clim = ee.ImageCollection("UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY")\ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(10,1,'month'))\ .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(274,4))\ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1991,2020,'year')) if clim.size().getInfo()==0: print("No climatology images"); print("C1") exit() clim_sum = clim.sum().rename('clim') # 3. Recent season 1 Oct 2023 – 4 Jan 2024 rec = ee.ImageCollection("UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY")\ .filterDate('2023-10-01','2024-01-04') if rec.size().getInfo()==0: print("No 2023-24 images"); print("C1") exit() rec_sum = rec.sum().rename('rec') # 4. Regional means (mm) and pixel counts scale=5000 c_mean = clim_sum.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=reg, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('clim').getInfo() c_cnt = clim_sum.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=reg, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('clim').getInfo() r_mean = rec_sum.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=reg, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('rec').getInfo() r_cnt = rec_sum.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=reg, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('rec').getInfo() # 5. Output print(f"Clim 91-20: {c_mean:.1f} mm (pixels {int(c_cnt)})") print(f"2023-24: {r_mean:.1f} mm (pixels {int(r_cnt)})") if c_mean is None or r_mean is None or c_cnt==0 or r_cnt==0: print("C3") elif r_mean > c_mean: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Region: East-Midlands + NE-England + E-Scotland (simplified MultiPolygon)
reg = ee.Geometry.MultiPolygon(
          [[[[-1.0,53.5],[-1.0,52.7],[-0.3,52.7],[-0.3,53.5]],
            [[-2.3,55.8],[-2.3,54.7],[-0.5,54.7],[-0.5,55.8]],
            [[-3.8,56.3],[-3.8,55.7],[-2.0,55.7],[-2.0,56.3]]]])

# 2. Build climatology (1991-2020) for 1 Oct – 4 Jan
clim = ee.ImageCollection("UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY")\
         .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(10,1,'month'))\
         .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(274,4))\
         .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1991,2020,'year'))
if clim.size().getInfo()==0:
    print("No climatology images"); print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()
clim_sum = clim.sum().rename('clim')

# 3. Recent season 1 Oct 2023 – 4 Jan 2024
rec = ee.ImageCollection("UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY")\
        .filterDate('2023-10-01','2024-01-04')
if rec.size().getInfo()==0:
    print("No 2023-24 images"); print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()
rec_sum = rec.sum().rename('rec')

# 4. Regional means (mm) and pixel counts
scale=5000
c_mean = clim_sum.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=reg, scale=scale,
            maxPixels=1e9).get('clim').getInfo()
c_cnt  = clim_sum.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=reg, scale=scale,
            maxPixels=1e9).get('clim').getInfo()
r_mean = rec_sum.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=reg, scale=scale,
            maxPixels=1e9).get('rec').getInfo()
r_cnt  = rec_sum.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=reg, scale=scale,
            maxPixels=1e9).get('rec').getInfo()

# 5. Output
print(f"Clim 91-20: {c_mean:.1f} mm  (pixels {int(c_cnt)})")
print(f"2023-24:    {r_mean:.1f} mm  (pixels {int(r_cnt)})")
if c_mean is None or r_mean is None or c_cnt==0 or r_cnt==0:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif r_mean > c_mean:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
